REDEEM: NOT IMPLEMENTED at UI layer (see PLOY-2-A-00). Discount field exists in PosOrderRequest line 88 but no UI flow to populate it with loyalty-derived value

REDEEM (pre-order): POST /api/loyalty/redeem with code + points → decrement balance + create ledger row (order_id=NULL)

loyalty_capabilities: Generate QR for kiosk scan (loyalty_code embedded)
Apple Wallet / Google Wallet pass (loyalty-07, loyalty-08 specs)

findings.title: source_surface mislabels mobile redemptions as 'pos'
findings.finding: LoyaltyController::redeem line 316: `'source_surface' => $isKiosk ? 'kiosk' : 'pos'` — binary fork ignores mobile. When mobile-app calls /api/loyalty/redeem with the user's own session (not kiosk:order ability), $isKiosk=false → labeled 'pos'. Analytics 'POS redemption volume' is polluted with mobile redemptions.
findings.remediation: Replace the binary with surface-detection: accept a 'source' param in request (validated against whitelist 'kiosk|pos|mobile|web'), or detect via User-Agent header, or pass via mobile-app authenticator. Simplest: add request input ['source' => 'in:kiosk,pos,mobile,web'] and use it (with fallback to current logic). Or: gate source_surface='pos' on caller having 'POS Operator' role specifically.

findings.title: Balance display drift between surfaces — no push/refresh after mutation
findings.finding: If customer redeems at kiosk while their mobile app is open, the mobile app's balance display remains stale (no websocket/push). Mobile spec loyalty-03-qr-refresh implies the mobile app polls/refreshes the QR but not necessarily the balance. Cross-surface balance is eventually consistent via Read-from-DB on each surface fetch.
findings.remediation: V1: document the polling cadence + accept stale read. V2: WebSocket loyalty.{user_id} channel broadcast on every LoyaltyTransaction insert. Pattern available via existing PusherService.

findings.title: Web surface has no loyalty integration — owner-decision gap
findings.finding: Per project_goal_longterm_executed_2026-05-17 BRAIN entry, web is standalone V1 mirror of mobile (44/44 E2E green). No loyalty endpoints called. If owner expected web account-page loyalty display, it's missing.
findings.remediation: Owner gate. Probably V1.0.2 backlog (web account section).

findings.title: Cross-surface earn parity: POS sets source_surface='pos' at order-create, kiosk='kiosk', but listener overrides to 'kiosk' for KIOSK/TAKEAWAY order_type
findings.finding: Listener line 113: `$surface = $order->source_surface ?? ($isKiosk ? 'kiosk' : 'web')`. Reads existing source_surface from order (good — preserves what was set at order create). But fallback for KIOSK/TAKEAWAY without source_surface defaults to 'kiosk' — POS-created TAKEAWAY orders (where cashier marks 'à emporter') would inherit 'pos' from line 919 set at OrderService::posOrderStore. Consistency verified by code reading.

findings.title: FrontendOrder cancellation calls refundPoints with sourceSurface='kiosk' — but kiosk-paid orders might have been created via mobile pre-order
findings.finding: FrontendOrderService::changeStatus refund call hard-codes 'kiosk' as sourceSurface. If a FrontendOrder was actually originated from mobile (source_surface='mobile' on the order row), the refund row's source_surface diverges from the original.

notes: Cross-surface architecture is consistent at the persistence layer (single users.loyalty_points + single loyalty_transactions ledger). Concerns are analytics-tag drift (P2s) and UX freshness (P2 balance drift). No corruption risk.
